text: There are three purchases on my debit card from a city I have never visited. I still have the card with me and the money is gone from my checking account.
I paid a seller I found online for a phone. They stopped answering and the listing disappeared. The payment app says it cannot help because I sent the money myself.
Someone opened a credit card in my name. I found out from a collection letter. I never applied for it.
My account has been frozen for two weeks for a review. My paycheck is inside and I cannot pay my rent. Nobody tells me what they need from me.
I cannot log in since I changed phones. The verification step keeps failing. I can still use my card at stores.
The bank closed my account last year and sent me a check for the balance, which I received. I would still like to know why it was closed.
I returned a jacket to the store a month ago and the store confirmed it, but the credit has not appeared on my card. The card company says to wait.
I ordered furniture that arrived broken. I asked my card company to dispute the charge and they sided with the shop without looking at my photos.
A gym kept charging me after I cancelled in writing. I asked my card issuer for a refund of the last charge and was refused.
A transfer to my sister has shown as pending for six days. The money left my account but she has not received it.
I deposited a check at the machine and only half of the amount was credited. The receipt shows the full amount.
My automatic mortgage payment was sent twice this month because of an error in the bank's bill pay system. One copy was returned yesterday so it is fixed now.
I was charged a monthly maintenance fee even though my balance never went below the minimum. I want the fee removed.
The promotional interest rate on my card ended three months earlier than the offer said it would, and interest has been added to my statement.
I opened a savings account for a bonus. I met every requirement and the bonus has not been paid.
The representative hung up on me twice and the supervisor never called back as promised. My original question has since been answered.
I keep receiving marketing calls from my bank several times a week although I asked them to stop.
If the bank does not return the overdraft fees it charged me, I will speak to a lawyer next week.
I believe I was refused a higher card limit because of my national origin. The employee made comments about my accent.
Please see the attached. As discussed before, it still has not been done and I expect an answer.
